descriptions.preferred: This very beautiful selection has distinct foliage which is very attractive in all seasons. The bright green leaves take full sun without burning. The fall colors are very spectacular and persist for a long period, blends of yellow and gold, mottled and shaded crimson. The medium-sized leaf has 11 lobes which are long, ovate-acuminate with sharp, narrow tips, separated distinctly over halfway to the leaf base. The margins roll slightly downward, making the separation between lobes more distinct. Shoots are a dusty green with prominent white striations. This sturdy, upright small tree forms a rounded canopy and matures at about 26 ft. (8 m) high. It is hardy and accepts a wide range of culture conditions. The name means "palmate-leaved. " Acer sieboldianum Siebold's maple The bright green small to medium-sized leaves are round with 7-11 ovate lobes separating up to halfway to the base. Each lobe terminates in a sharp point and has sharply toothed margins. The undersurface and leafstalks are covered with a fine white down at first, which diminishes during the summer. Fall color is outstanding, turning a brilliant scarlet with some orange. This species is one of the most common in the mountain woods and thickets of Japan. It forms a tall multistemmed shrub or small tree up to 33 ft. (10 m) tall. It can be depended upon for fall color and makes a very hardy, trouble-free plant for mixed landscapes. The specific name honors German botanist Philipp F. von Siebold.

sources.title: 帕提佛 Acer Shirasawanum 'Palmatifolium'
sources.description: 一个非常美丽的品种，叶形独特。 春夏绿，秋色让人惊叹，而且非常持久，是一种黄色与金色混杂的色彩，同时会渲染出深红色。 叶裂为 11 裂，裂叶呈长圆形，叶尖短促而锋利。 叶裂深度超过叶片的一半，裂叶呈放射性展开。 叶缘锯齿明显，且稍稍向下卷曲，使得裂叶间的间隙扩大，叶片背面的叶脉也非常明显。 叶片直径可达 10cm 。 嫩枝树皮呈灰绿色，并带有明显的白色条纹，老枝则转为更暗沉的灰绿色。 帕提佛树势健壮，树形直立，树冠呈圆形，成熟株高 8m 。 它耐寒性良好，环境适应性强。

rhs.description: A deciduous small tree or large shrub, to around 5m high, with rounded leaves divided into up to 11 coarsely toothed lobes. Leaves emerge pale green tinted with pink, and turn bright green in summer before colouring orange, red and purple in autumn. Clusters of creamy-yellow flowers in spring are followed by brownish-red winged fruits

care.cultivation: Grows best in slightly acidic, humus-rich, well-drained soil, but tolerates most soils if improved with well-rotted organic matter . Hot, dry air, cold wind and late frost may cause leaf scorching. Mulch in autumn to protect shallow roots from cold and drying out. See Japanese maple cultivation
care.pruning: Minimal pruning required; see pruning group 1 . Prune from late autumn to mid-winter only

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这一极为美丽的选育品种具有鲜明而独特的叶貌，四季皆具观赏性。 鲜绿色叶片在全日照下也不易灼伤。 秋色极其壮观且持续时间长，呈黄、金色与斑驳、晕染的深红色混合。 中等大小的叶片具 11 个裂片，裂片长、呈卵状渐尖形，先端狭长锐尖，分裂深度明显超过叶片的一半。 叶缘略向下卷，使裂片间分离感更为清晰。 新梢为灰绿色，并有显著的白色条纹。 该品种树势强健、株形直立，成熟后形成圆整树冠，高约 26 英尺（8 米）。 其耐寒，且能适应较广泛的栽培条件。 其名称意为“掌叶形”。 Acer sieboldianum，Siebold's maple。 其鲜绿色叶片小至中等大小，近圆形，具 7 至 11 个卵形裂片，分裂深度可达叶基的一半。 每个裂片先端尖锐，叶缘具明显锯齿。 叶背和叶柄初期覆有细白色绒毛，至夏季会逐渐减少。 秋色极为出众，转为鲜艳的猩红色并带部分橙色。 该种是日本山地林地和灌丛中最常见的槭树之一，可形成高大的丛生灌木或小乔木，高可达 33 英尺（10 米）。 其秋色表现稳定可靠，是混合景观中非常耐寒且少病少害、管理省心的植物。 种加词是为纪念德国植物学家 Philipp F. von Siebold。

care.cultivation: 在微酸性、富含腐殖质且排水良好的土壤中生长最佳，但若加入充分腐熟的有机质改良，也能适应多数土壤。炎热干燥的空气、寒风和晚霜可能导致叶片焦枯。秋季覆 mulch，可保护浅根免受寒害和干燥。参见 Japanese maple cultivation。
care.pruning: 所需修剪极少；参见修剪第 1 组。仅可在晚秋至仲冬期间修剪。
care.propagation: 可采用压条或嫁接繁殖。

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 落叶性小乔木或大型灌木，高约 5 米。 叶片近圆形，分裂为最多 11 个粗齿裂片。 新叶展开时为带粉色晕染的淡绿色，夏季转为鲜绿色，秋季变为橙色、红色和紫色。 春季开成簇的乳黄色花，随后结棕红色翅果。
